raw_data_rule: The raw CSV is immutable; all transformations use an intermediate copy.
amendment_2026_09_04: Added sentinel_policy below (the -9999 wind-sensor sentinel found in artifacts/data_quality_report.json is now mapped to NaN before hourly resampling, so it cannot corrupt a mean/max aggregate). Also corrected gap_policy.input_imputation: it previously fell back to a train-median fill for any gap longer than forward_fill_max_hours, which contradicted this file's own gap_policy.long_gaps rule below ("mark the gap and prevent sliding windows from crossing it"). A gap beyond forward_fill_max_hours is now left as NaN, which is what actually makes WeatherForecastDataset drop a window that touches it - see src/data/preprocessing.py and configs/data.yaml (the editable source of truth these values are kept in sync with).

duplicate_policy.resolution: After parsing and sorting, keep the first row for each duplicate timestamp.

gap_policy.short_gaps: Do not reconstruct missing raw 10-minute rows; aggregate available observations into hourly bins.
gap_policy.long_gaps: Mark the gap and prevent sliding windows from crossing it.
